title: Fresh lanterns: 12 new designs (green)
desc: J dropped all 12 of v2.0103 ("Didnt like all 12"), asked for "New stuff" and picked "Fresh lantern designs": 12 new silhouettes that are not reliquaries, voxel pixel art with polished gold, the G3-flare core and the lit port. Stills at frame 118.

takes.name: Classic battery lantern
takes.facts: green; the iconic lantern: an octagonal glass drum behind gold bars and engraved bands, stepped cap with lit vents, a gold bail handle; lit port; 607 boxes

takes.name: Pagoda
takes.facts: green; three shrinking glass storeys on bronze posts, flared gold roofs with lit upturned corners, a ringed spire; lit port; 994 boxes

takes.name: Storm lantern
takes.facts: green; a bulbous glass globe in a bowed gold guard cage, a bronze fuel tank below, a stepped chimney and a wire bail; lit port; 866 boxes

takes.name: Faceted gem

takes.name: Crescent moon
